concept: Inspector: vulnerability scanning for EC2 and container images
tests: Choosing a service to automatically find software vulnerabilities and network exposure of EC2/containers.
expected: Amazon Inspector continuously scans EC2 and ECR images for CVEs and network reachability. Triggers: "software vulnerabilities", "container images", "unintended network exposure".
why_not: GuardDuty is log-based threat detection; Config is configuration compliance; Macie finds sensitive data in S3.
